subject.title: feat: add publisher follow graph API

question: Should ClawHub accept a publisher-scoped follow graph API as core now, or pause this base slice until the controls and notification stack are reviewed together?
rationale: The code is a plausible base implementation, but it creates a new private follow-state API and product boundary that automation cannot approve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after proof and docs
options.body: Proceed with this base API once real runtime proof, public API contract docs, generated artifacts, and conflict resolution are complete.

options.title: Pause for stack review
options.body: Hold this base PR until the dependent controls/discovery and notification PRs are reviewed as one product boundary.

options.title: Decline this API shape
options.body: Close or redirect the stack if maintainers do not want follow state exposed as a core ClawHub API now.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and docs
recommendation.body: Proceed with this base API once real runtime proof, public API contract docs, generated artifacts, and conflict resolution are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest current-main owner signal for the API route, schema package, retention, and release-sensitive Convex surfaces this PR changes.
